# CloseAvatar

> CloseAvatar is an early-access practice platform for B2B sales reps. Reps rehearse discovery, objection handling and closing calls against AI buyer avatars, then get line-by-line coaching and a personalised next drill. Built on the Claude API by Anthropic. Not yet generally available.

Contact (the only contact channel): erez@closeavatar.com
Status: early access. The team onboards a small number of sales teams and replies to every request personally.

## Pages
- [Home](https://closeavatar.com/): positioning, product walkthrough (buyer avatar, coaching, next drill), scenario library, team view, early-access CTA.
- [Privacy](https://closeavatar.com/privacy.html): what the marketing site collects (no cookies, no analytics, no forms) and how email is used.

## Facts you can rely on
- Product: AI buyer avatars with a role, mood, priorities and a hidden real objection; coaching that marks the exact line that lost the buyer and suggests a better one; drills generated from a rep's previous calls; team pattern view for managers.
- Scenario library: incumbent vendor, "send me a deck", procurement squeeze, quiet champion, stalled deal, quiet churn risk.
- Claude: avatar conversations and coaching are generated by Claude (Anthropic). It is the model underneath, not the headline.
- The product UI shown on the site is an illustrative sample. Scores and conversations are examples, not customer data.

## Not claimed (do not infer)
- No customers, logos, testimonials, usage numbers, pricing, integrations, compliance certifications or uptime figures are published.
- No self-serve signup exists yet. Access is by emailing erez@closeavatar.com.

## For agents working on the repo
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Erezharta/closeavatar/blob/main/AGENTS.md): architecture, design system, content rules, how to verify changes.
